title: Refundable Value by Days Kept — Self-Pay PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Refundable Value by Days Kept — Self-Pay PAP Therapy Equipment

**Sale terms.** The refundable value of a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit that comes back for a refund — the amount from which the refund is taken and on which its restocking fee is charged — depends on the days the patient kept the unit:

- a unit kept **more than 21 days** loses **0.4 percent** of the price for each of days 15 to 21 and a further **0.8 percent** of the price for each day kept beyond 21;
- a unit kept **more than 14 and up to 21 days** loses 0.4 percent of the price for each day kept beyond 14;
- a unit kept **14 days or less** is refunded at the full price.

The price is the device price charged on the sale line being refunded. The refundable value is the price multiplied by the share that remains after those percentages, rounded half up to the cent, and is the base of the restocking fee.

**Base of the restocking fee.** For a self-pay refund this policy governs, and only for such a refund, the class's restocking percentage is taken of the refundable value worked out here rather than of the full device price.

**Days kept.** Counted from the delivery date on the device record to the date the completed return pickup request records the unit as received back (the decision date of that completed request): calendar days from the one date to the other, the delivery date itself not counted.

## Percent of the price lost

| Days kept | Percent lost |
|---|---|
| 14 | 0 |
| 15 | 0.4 |
| 21 | 2.8 (7 days at 0.4) |
| 22 | 3.6 (2.8 plus 0.8) |
| 25 | 6.0 (2.8 plus 4 days at 0.8) |

## Worked values (hypothetical price of 899.00)

- 14 days kept: refundable value 899.00.
- 18 days kept: 4 days at 0.4 is 1.6 percent; 899.00 multiplied by 98.4 percent is 884.616, rounded half up to 884.62.
- 25 days kept: 6.0 percent lost; 899.00 multiplied by 94.0 percent is 845.06.
